answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable bond that only unlocks after sustained, verifiable work: fresh identities must pay in time as well as coin. A new identity is like a karst cavern, cheap to enter but costly to map, while an established one accumulates a reef of attested history a forger cannot fake overnight. Set the bond so spawning a thousand sock puppets costs more than the rewards they could siphon, and grade the mesa of long-run behaviour so attackers must keep paying to stay credible.
